principles: Existing sample width/length accessors reused only after literal specimen/value/unit source proof.
Unknown original quantity labels, expressions, units, source identity and scope retained in unresolved records instead of inventing global properties.
Figure/table-only numeric proposals retain original page/bbox/header/cell and remain UNRESOLVED.
Unique tested-article acronyms are source-version-bound and review-only; they create no global alias or automatic measurement.
RDF carries isolated scientific proposals; hashes/paths/chunks/cache keys and operational receipts remain in package registry/index.
limitation: Unknown properties and ambiguous statement applicability still require scientific review; evidence retention is not confirmed scientific recovery.
